description:
WARNING: this file is the source manifest Morphe Manager reads from raw.githubusercontent.com, not a build artifact. It must be updated by hand on every release (the upstream semantic-release pipeline used to do this, and this repo cut it to avoid exposing a read:packages PAT to CI). Blank version / download_url / created_at make the patch source impossible to add.

RailOne (org.cris.aikyam) anti-tamper bypasses: disable the native security SDK, USB-debugging detection, APK signature verification and the rjsniffer adb_enabled check. Verified against RailOne 2.1.66 and 2.1.62.
